(()=>{
 const KEY='portfolio-evidence-transforms-v1';
 let saved={};try{saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'{}')||{}}catch(e){}
 const key=im=>{const t=im.closest('.tile'),slot=im.closest('.slot'),sheet=im.closest('.sheet');if(!t||!slot||!sheet)return null;const slots=[...sheet.querySelectorAll('.slot')];const tiles=[...slot.querySelectorAll('.tile')];const sheets=[...sheet.parentElement.querySelectorAll('.sheet')];return [sheets.indexOf(sheet),slots.indexOf(slot),tiles.indexOf(t),im.getAttribute('src')?.length||0].join(':')};
 function apply(im,v){im.style.transform='translate('+v.x+'px,'+v.y+'px) scale('+v.z+')';}
 function install(im){
  if(im.dataset.gestureReady)return;
  im.dataset.gestureReady='1';
  const k=key(im);if(!k)return;
  let v=saved[k]||{x:0,y:0,z:1};apply(im,v);
  const save=()=>{saved[k]={...v};try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(saved))}catch(e){}};
  const pts=new Map();let anchor=null;
  const dist=(a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y);
  im.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(e.pointerType==='mouse'&&e.button!==0)return;e.preventDefault();im.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);pts.set(e.pointerId,{x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY});anchor=null;});
  im.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
   if(!pts.has(e.pointerId))return;e.preventDefault();
   const prev=[...pts.values()];pts.set(e.pointerId,{x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY});const now=[...pts.values()];
   if(now.length===1){v.x+=now[0].x-prev[0].x;v.y+=now[0].y-prev[0].y;}
   else if(now.length>=2){const a=dist(prev[0],prev[1]),b=dist(now[0],now[1]);if(a>0)v.z=Math.max(.25,Math.min(5,v.z*b/a));v.x+=((now[0].x+now[1].x)-(prev[0].x+prev[1].x))/2;v.y+=((now[0].y+now[1].y)-(prev[0].y+prev[1].y))/2;}
   apply(im,v);save();
  });
  for(const ev of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])im.addEventListener(ev,e=>{pts.delete(e.pointerId);save()});
  im.addEventListener('wheel',e=>{if(!e.ctrlKey&&!e.metaKey)return;e.preventDefault();v.z=Math.max(.25,Math.min(5,v.z*(e.deltaY<0?1.08:.92)));apply(im,v);save()},{passive:false});
  const tile=im.closest('.tile');if(tile&&!tile.querySelector('.evidence-zoom')){
   const bar=document.createElement('div');bar.className='evidence-zoom';
   for(const [label,fn] of [['+',()=>v.z=Math.min(5,v.z*1.15)],['−',()=>v.z=Math.max(.25,v.z/1.15)],['↺',()=>{v={x:0,y:0,z:1}}]]){
    const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.textContent=label;b.title=label==='+'?'تكبير الصورة':label==='−'?'تصغير الصورة':'إعادة ضبط الصورة';b.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();fn();apply(im,v);save()});bar.append(b);
   }tile.append(bar);
  }
 }

 new MutationObserver(sync).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true});sync();

})();

(function(){
const STORE='evidence-controls-v2';
let data={};try{data=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE)||'{}')||{}}catch(e){}
const pages=document.getElementById('pages');
const printRoot=document.getElementById('printRoot');
function pageKey(im){const tile=im.closest('.tile'),slot=im.closest('.slot'),sheet=im.closest('.sheet');if(!tile||!slot||!sheet)return null;return [Array.from(pages.children).indexOf(sheet),Array.from(sheet.querySelectorAll('.slot')).indexOf(slot),Array.from(slot.querySelectorAll('.tile')).indexOf(tile)].join(':')}
function transform(im,v){im.style.setProperty('transform','translate('+v.x+'px,'+v.y+'px) scale('+v.z+')','important')}
function install(im){
if(im.dataset.evidenceV2)return;const k=pageKey(im);if(!k)return;
im.dataset.evidenceV2='1';let v=data[k]||{x:0,y:0,z:1};transform(im,v);
const save=()=>{data[k]={...v};try{localStorage.setItem(STORE,JSON.stringify(data))}catch(e){}};
const tile=im.closest('.tile'),bar=document.createElement('div');bar.className='evidence-controls';
for(const [label,act] of [['−',()=>v.z=Math.max(.2,v.z/1.2)],['+',()=>v.z=Math.min(6,v.z*1.2)],['↺',()=>v={x:0,y:0,z:1}]]){
const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.textContent=label;b.setAttribute('aria-label',label==='−'?'تصغير الصورة':label==='+'?'تكبير الصورة':'إعادة ضبط الصورة');
b.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();act();transform(im,v);save()});bar.appendChild(b)}
tile.appendChild(bar);
const pointers=new Map();
im.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(e.pointerType==='mouse'&&e.button!==0)return;e.preventDefault();try{im.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(x){}pointers.set(e.pointerId,{x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY})});
im.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!pointers.has(e.pointerId))return;e.preventDefault();const before=Array.from(pointers.values());pointers.set(e.pointerId,{x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY});const after=Array.from(pointers.values());if(after.length===1){v.x+=after[0].x-before[0].x;v.y+=after[0].y-before[0].y}else if(after.length>=2){const d=a=>Math.hypot(a[0].x-a[1].x,a[0].y-a[1].y);if(d(before)>0)v.z=Math.max(.2,Math.min(6,v.z*d(after)/d(before)));v.x+=(after[0].x+after[1].x-before[0].x-before[1].x)/2;v.y+=(after[0].y+after[1].y-before[0].y-before[1].y)/2}transform(im,v);save()});
for(const name of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])im.addEventListener(name,e=>{pointers.delete(e.pointerId);save()});
}
function sync(){
if(!pages)return;
pages.querySelectorAll('.slot .tile>img').forEach(install);
if(printRoot){const sheets=Array.from(printRoot.children);sheets.forEach((sheet,i)=>sheet.querySelectorAll('.slot').forEach((slot,j)=>slot.querySelectorAll('.tile>img').forEach((im,k)=>{const v=data[[i,j,k].join(':')];if(v)transform(im,v)})))}
}
const observer=new MutationObserver(sync);observer.observe(document.body,{subtree:true,childList:true});sync();window.addEventListener('beforeprint',sync);
})();
</script></body></html>
